why: A check of a large drive used to say nothing until every file had been listed, read and hashed, and a 24-hour run that died said nothing at all. Things that run by themselves come first: a folder-open task is read the moment the walk meets it and shown under step 1, before the project files are read in step 2 or a single large file is hashed in step 3. Each finding is on the screen and in the report file as it is made, with the time each step took, and the full report follows at the end as before (ADR-0059).

findings.match: tasks.json runs on folder open AND contains an indicator
mentions something the campaign also uses
